Em que sistemas ele está ligado: Which systems it is connected to
No meio está a foto do agente (ou o logo: The agent’s photo is in the center (or the DG Claw logo if there is no photo). Each surrounding tile represents an external system the agent has used (WhatsApp, Instagram, banking, invoicing, and others). A straight line connects each tile to the agent. Tap a tile for details. A system appears here automatically the first time the agent uses it.
Aqui você responde \"o meu agente está c: Here you can answer “what is my agent connected to, and is it working?” without opening each system. It also serves as a showcase during a class: you can show all the agent’s connections to the outside world at once.
Conta em quantos sistemas o agente está: Counts how many systems the agent is connected to and how many are not working. Systems you disabled on the map are excluded from the connected count. Beside it is the switch between Actual status and Presentation mode.
É a resposta rápida para \"está tudo bem: It quickly answers “is everything okay?”. If something is not working, the count appears here before you look for the red tile on the map.
A cor vem do uso real, anotado pelos pro: The color comes from actual use, recorded by the programs that communicate with each system, rather than from a test run by the panel. Green: the agent’s last use succeeded. Yellow: a potentially temporary problem occurred (no internet, a usage limit, or an uncertain result), or there was a single failure that has not yet been confirmed. Red: two serious failures at least 2 minutes apart with no success afterward, or WhatsApp reporting that the device disconnected. Gray: disabled by you. Light blue: no use for more than 7 days. Each status also has its own shape beside the word (a circle with a check, a triangle, a diamond with an X, a dashed circle, and a clock), so color is not the only clue. A small square moves along the line when the system is working; for red, it stops in the middle at an X. Nearer tiles look larger, and more distant tiles look smaller and slightly faded, just to add depth.
A cor nunca é chute: um sistema sem uso: The color is never a guess: a system without recent use never appears green, because a color is only trustworthy when it comes from actual use. Red requires two failures so that a brief internet interruption does not cause a false alarm.
Mostra a última vez que o sistema funcio: Shows the last successful use of the system, an explanation of the latest problem, and which skills use that system. The button disables the system on the map (the tile and line become dashed) or enables it again.
Quando algo fica vermelho, o cartão diz: When something turns red, the card tells you what happened and when, so you know what to ask the agent. Disabling a system on the map only changes the drawing and the count: it does not disconnect anything in the actual system.
O Estado real mostra todos os sistemas,: Actual status shows all systems in their current colors. Presentation mode only shows green systems, so you can present without displaying systems that have problems.
Numa apresentação você quer mostrar o qu: During a presentation, you want to show what works. Presentation mode hides the other systems, but never colors a system green unless it really is green.
